# LitigaForge AI

> LitigaForge AI is a legal-technology platform for advocates and clients. It provides AI-assisted legal information, document analysis, judgment research, free legal-aid information, and practical case tools.

## Platform Overview

LitigaForge AI helps people understand legal information and helps advocates organize research and drafting work. It is not a law firm and does not provide legal advice. AI output can be wrong and should be checked by a qualified advocate.

## Core Features

- [Legal information Q&A](/ask): Ask a legal question and receive AI-generated legal information in plain language.
- [Document Analyzer](/review): Review a document for potential risks, missing clauses, and questions to discuss with an advocate.
- [Lawyer Directory](/lawyers): Browse advocates who have been human-verified and choose to be listed. If no eligible advocate is available, the service shows an empty state rather than a match.
- [Judgment Finder](/judgments): Search Indian court judgments and case law by keyword, court name, or case number.
- [AI Legal Chat](/legal-chat): AI-assisted legal-information and drafting workspace.
- [Free Legal Documents](/free-documents): Document templates and drafting tools.
- [Free Legal Aid Finder](/legal-aid): Find relevant legal-aid information and public contacts.
- [Subscription Plans](/subscription): Free tier, Advocate Pro ₹999/month, and Chamber ₹2,499/month.

## Target Users

- Litigants and small businesses
- Advocates and legal-aid organizations
- Legal-aid organizations

## Geographic Coverage

The product provides practical legal tools for advocates and clients.

## Languages

English, Telugu, Hindi

## Legal Disclaimer

This is not legal advice and not a substitute for an advocate. AI can be wrong. For representation, consult a qualified advocate.
